policies.raw_columns: All 14 source columns required for the reference training/evaluation import; match by name, reject missing/unknown/duplicate headers. Preserve raw file unchanged.
policies.scoring: Require six features, not labels. Record identity and version are required for persisted batch outputs. Scoring API/adapter is not implemented.
policies.invalid_values: Report errors; do not silently fill, drop, coerce or repair labels. Missing, non-finite numeric values and invalid categorical/binary values require explicit handling before use.
policies.label_consistency: Keep original target and all failure modes; flag disagreements and overlapping modes for analysis.
policies.external_datasets: No automatic compatibility claim; eligibility and physical equivalence need a separate decision.
